Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, Darrell Yates Rist, and Tim Coglin 2. Short news stories 3. New York Native reports that AIDS caused by syphilis spirochetes COMMERCIAL: Night of a Thousand Gowns charity drag ball 4. Catholic Church ejecting gay groups from their churches and forbidding them to meet or worship there COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 5. Andy Humm on the marriage of an ex-gay man with AIDS in a Catholic Church 6. News Watch, bill introduced in Maryland to remove state's sodomy laws 7. LAMBDA legal defense hires a third attorney to full-time staff to deal exclusively with AIDS-related issues 8. Chicago, low income gays suffer discrimination at a greater rate and degree 9. New York, judge rules that funeral homes charging more for burial of AIDS victims are doing so illegally 10. San Francisco, Mayor Diane Feinstein announces a reward for information leading to the arrest of the murderer of two gay men in the city's Castro district in December of 1986 11. Arizona governor, Evan Mecham, declares that homosexuality is not a valid alternative lifestyle and therefore has no place in any argument concerning human rights 12. Sports Report 13. Lavender Health, interview with Dr. Joan Waitkevicz of the lesbian-centered St. Marks Women's Health Collective 14. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Media Watch with Brandon Judell, interview with William H. Hoffman, playwright of "As Is," with clips of the television film COMMERCIAL: Zamir Furs 2. Show Bits with George Trahanis, review of "Vicki's Valentine Thing," with clips COMMERCIAL: Night of a Thousand Gowns charity drag ball 3. Razor Sharp introduces a contest to win a date with her COMMERCIAL: The Monster 4. Closing credits
